Grounding stays the last operating-instruction bullet; its following warning retains the original source lockup.
Return all stripped body copy to its original field inside its own model drawing. White AC charging caption has no gray speech panel. No extra speech pointers.
LCD mode retains original side-by-side proportions and six actions. Key table retains all 4 original plus marks, exact source clock, 3 columns and mobile scrolling.
Restore exact original white signal glyph; retain both 3+4 source pictogram panels and seven source-bound symbol admissions.

All numeric/condition rows retained. Specifications have source small headings, source label weight and USB-C shared label spanning two value rows. V_oc and chemical subscripts remain source-authored.
FCC navigation title remains hidden because the source panel has no printed FCC heading.
Original labels, button silk, leaders and screenshots remain original artwork; source labels are also bound in figure metadata. Expanded tight panel crops preserve actual source frame/stroke bounds.
Earlier LCD crop repair retained: all 25 numbered labels and leaders complete, verified against original source.
Earlier four plus separators retained as native text between the original button images.
